design_principles: One logical dataset = one canonical layer ID.
Packs/presets activate canonical IDs; they never duplicate layer declarations.
Observed evidence, contextual reference, derived analytics, and experimental layers must remain distinguishable.
A visible map layer is not automatically a valid ML feature.
Every layer must carry source, provider, license, temporal status, data quality, and scientific role.
Derived risk or pressure layers never replace the underlying evidence layers.

Índices, heatmaps, riesgo, fricción y productos analíticos derivados.
